high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website indiatoday.in, as indicated by the header at the top. The article is titled "Heavy rain lashes parts of Tamil Nadu, several areas waterlogged." It is categorized under the India section, specifically focusing on Tamil Nadu. The content of the article states that Thoothukudi district in Tamil Nadu received heavy rain in the early hours of Friday, leading to waterlogging in many areas of the city. The article mentions that commuters face difficulties due to these conditions.
